caption: The drawing depicts two figures, one larger and one smaller. The larger figure stands upright and has long brown hair, a light complexion, and wears a large, ornate gold crown. This figure is dressed in a red robe with a blue mantle that has gold trim. The right arm is bent at the elbow, and the hand is holding a rod-like object. The left arm is extended outward, supporting the smaller figure. The smaller figure also has a light complexion and is naked except for a gold crown with decorative elements. The smaller figure's left arm is extended outward while the right arm is at its side. The background is plain and off-white. The artist’s signature, "MILTON R. BEVIER," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Virgin and Child
